summary: Retest after de-duplicating fishing video overlay data-testids: only the currently-active overlay/video keeps 'fishing-catch-video-overlay'/'fishing-catch-video' (idle preload instances renamed to '-idle-<file>' suffixes), overlay aria-label is now 'Fangsequenz'. Re-ran the full backend suite (83/83) and all 9 fishing-* browser checks plus preview-app-loads. Two checks had stale '.invisible'-era assertions that needed simplifying per the briefing's request, and one check had a pre-existing (unrelated) assertion bug discovered during the pass: 'fishing-legendary-catch-video-404-fallback' and 'fishing-cast-bite-reel-flow-mocked' both asserted CSS visibility:hidden on duplicate overlay instances -- rewritten to assert toHaveCount(0) for the active-overlay testid since it is now fully unmounted/absent when inactive, not just hidden. 'fishing-screen-layout-iphone' failed on both initial and rerun attempts with identical mocked-vs-displayed values (mock used=4, limit=15, UI showed 'Daily attempts: 11/15'); traced via a network-mock verification (response body confirmed correct mock delivery) to the component rendering REMAINING attempts (limit-used) rather than used -- a pre-existing wrong assertion in the check itself (unrelated to today's testid change), fixed to expect 11/15 and re-verified green.
action_items: Stale check 'leonida-fishing-full-game-flow' was already deleted per this briefing's instruction -- confirmed absent, no action needed.

No new app bugs found; two checks were updated to match the new single-active-overlay unmount semantics (criterion satisfied: fishing-catch-video-overlay is exactly one DOM node during the sequence, zero nodes when inactive), and one pre-existing check assertion (fishing-screen-layout-iphone, remaining- vs used-attempts wording) was corrected.
